blurb: The city of West Lake, which Marco Polo called the finest in the world.

facts.t: As governor in 1089, the poet Su Shi had West Lake dredged and used the mud to build a causeway with six bridges across it. It is still called the Su Causeway.
Marco Polo called Hangzhou Kinsay and wrote that it was the finest and noblest city in the world, with 12,000 bridges, probably an exaggeration.

src.n: Wikipedia: The Travels of Marco Polo
